auto-hide.label: Auto-hide when stopped
auto-hide.description: Hide the bar widget completely when media is stopped or no player is running

hide-when-paused.label: Hide when paused
hide-when-paused.description: Hide the bar widget when media is paused

max-words.label: Max Words Per Line
max-words.description: Maximum number of words displayed before shifting onto the next line chunk

word-wrapping-mode.label: Line Splitting Mode
word-wrapping-mode.description: Strategy for splitting long lyric lines across the bar

options.words: By word count (shift after max words)

font-size.label: Font Size
font-size.description: Text size of lyrics displayed on the bar

smooth-sweep.label: Smooth Karaoke Sweep
smooth-sweep.description: Progressive character-by-character color sweep across syllables in real time

show-countdown.label: Show Song Intro Countdown
show-countdown.description: Display seconds remaining until the first vocal line starts

timing-offset.label: Timing Offset (ms)
timing-offset.description: Shift lyric timing forward or backward in milliseconds (mouse wheel scroll on the bar widget also adjusts on the fly)

scroll-step.label: Scroll Adjustment Step (ms)
scroll-step.description: Milliseconds added or subtracted per mouse wheel scroll notch

invert-scroll.label: Invert Scroll Direction
invert-scroll.description: Invert mouse wheel scroll direction when adjusting timing offset

preferred-source.label: Preferred Lyric Provider
preferred-source.description: Service hierarchy for karaoke and synced lyrics

active-color.label: Active Syllable Color
active-color.description: Theme color token for the currently sung syllable/word (e.g. primary, tertiary, secondary)

sung-color.label: Sung Syllable Color
sung-color.description: Theme color token for completed syllables (e.g. on_surface, primary)

upcoming-color.label: Upcoming Syllable Color
upcoming-color.description: Theme color token for upcoming syllables (e.g. on_surface_variant, outline)

show-glyph.label: Show Music Icon
show-glyph.description: Display music glyph next to active lyrics

max-chars.label: Max Display Characters
max-chars.description: Maximum characters shown when character limit mode is selected

spicylyrics-key.label: Spicy Lyrics API Key
spicylyrics-key.description: API key for querying syllable-level lyrics on api.spicylyrics.org

betterlyrics-key.label: BetterLyrics API Key
betterlyrics-key.description: Optional API key for uncached queries on api.betterlyrics.org

spotify-client-id.label: Spotify Client ID
spotify-client-id.description: Optional Spotify app Client ID to resolve track IDs for non-Spotify players

spotify-client-secret.label: Spotify Client Secret
spotify-client-secret.description: Optional Spotify app Client Secret for track ID resolution

parsenix-base-url.label: Parsenix API Base URL
parsenix-base-url.description: Base URL of your deployed Parsenix Spotify Lyrics API instance (e.g. https://your-instance.vercel.app). Requires SP_DC cookie configured server-side.

panel.available-sources: Click any provider to switch lyrics instantly
